name: Sam Lim
home: the streets inland from Pier Beach
life: “I still remember taking down a retired colleague's framed qualifications.” On Friday, near the courtyard by Ferry Street Rooms, Sam prefers the bench where the sound of the shop door reaches before the visitor does.
voice: I am the young physician replacing her. My first week's schedule is full of people who want to say goodbye.
appearance: Sam has a flat bridge to the nose and a mobile brow. Look for short sandy hair and a marked widow's peak. Out of work clothes, the familiar outfit is a plum-colored cardigan with one loose pocket corner secured with green thread. In conversation Sam takes off the watch before a long conversation.
personality: Sam has excellent recall for voices and a poor memory for official titles. Someone who waited patiently at a counter years ago is more likely to be remembered than the person in charge.
agenda: To learn the regular patients' histories from them.
family: Luz Dean is Sam’s stepsibling. Sam remembers the birthdays. Luz asks what the birthday guest would like this year. A present that was perfect at sixteen may be completely wrong at forty. They take the trouble of finding out. Asked about *Names on the night wall*, Luz says, “I wrote the name of the grocer who holds my daughter's school bag when my watch runs late.”
connections: Bailey Moran. The longtime patient meets the successor while the departing physician can still make the introduction. Also in the story is Riley Macrae (departing physician).

reactions.situation: A patient asks the leaving doctor to stay one more month
reactions.response: Sam asks what handover would help the patient if the move date stands.

reactions.situation: Smoke appears under a shop door after closing
reactions.response: Sam alerts the nearest occupied shop, stays outside and writes down when the smoke first appeared.
